overall_summary: Data volume and view counts are extremely low across all 8 videos (max 20 views), indicating the algorithm has not yet found an audience seed. Confidence is low, but digital-life anchors like phone numbers and empty chats show slightly higher initial impressions.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos anchored around phone contacts ('पुराना नंबर', 20 views) and checking empty chats (14-17 views) outperformed abstract concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Anchor every emotional story in a specific modern phone interaction (typing, deleting, block list, unsent draft).

weak_patterns.evidence: The Self Respect video generated only 1 view, showing that preachy resolution lacks hook engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid preachy moralizing; keep the focus on raw, unresolved emotional micro-moments.

next_video.concept: Typing a 5-paragraph heart-out message to an old contact, only to delete it all and send a generic two-word response.
next_video.opening_direction: Show a long text response typed out on screen with specific emotional honesty.
next_video.twist_direction: The user selects all, hits backspace, and types 'All good, you tell?' instead.
next_video.reason: Tests early morning routine browsing when viewers reflect on unspoken thoughts before their day starts, doubling down on digital micro-behaviors.

experiment: Testing if visual un-sent draft/backspace mechanics yield higher retention than static quote reads.
